Recommended

I have had the good fortune of using some Horace products before today. As such I cam into this with a high opinion pf Horace products and was happily waiting to be wowed. Well....I can't say I was 'wowed' by this toner. It arrives in a plastic bottle with a very standard push down spray nozzle you've no doubt seen a million times before. The liquid itself is clear and watery like...er...water! The consistency is also water-like. It sprays out very well and to be fair it spreads onto the face pretty evenly and nicely it's just that...I don't really feel a whole lot afterwards to be honest with you. With a moisturiser or any similar cream I feel like I know when I've just used it. Perhaps that sounds silly but you know what I mean, right?! You apply moisturiser you feel softer and hydrated even. Here I apply this toner I just don't really feel anything. For me personally I'm not mightily impressed but I'm going to give four stars because it is all subjective. You may be reading this and actively looking for a mild face toner in which case this would be right up your street and ignore my semi-negative reaction. This is what I mean, one man's meat is another man's poison and all that. Order this by all means but consider that it is very light and mild and you won't be disappointed. Failure to read reviews before ordering and you may expect something different and potentially be disappointed.
